description: This header file defines the class DataElementFile within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class represents a file data element that encapsulates file operations such as loading, deleting, permissions management, and memory mapping. It extends the DataElement base class and provides methods for file manipulation and access.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: Represents a file as a data element with operations for managing the file, including loading, unlinking, destroying, and memory mapping.
